subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Payment Terms
description: Learn Payment Terms in one minute.

hook.text: Net 30 means you pay in 30 days. But the supplier offers 2% off if you pay in 10. That's 36% annualized.

buildup.text: Payment terms define when and how a buyer pays—immediately, upon delivery, or on credit.

discovery.text: Longer terms improve the buyer's cash flow. Early-pay discounts offer savings that compound fast.

twist.text: Stretching payment terms too far strains small suppliers. If they can't fund operations, quality suffers.

climax.text: Supply chain finance programs let suppliers get paid early through banks while buyers keep their terms.

punchline.text: Payment terms are a negotiation, not a default.

quiz.question: What does 2/10 Net 30 mean?
options: 2% discount if paid in 10 days, otherwise full in 30
